purpose: GEM-B2 closure: drop f_DES baseline column to resolve rank deficiency in 9-template design.
design: 8 templates: dipole_x, dipole_y, dipole_z, f_BASS_rel_DES, f_DECaLS_rel_DES, rho_p, rho_p^2, const. f_DES dropped as baseline (DES is the reference leg).
interpretation: Rank-resolved 8-template fit (f_DES dropped as baseline). Condition number cond(M) = 1.433e+01 (vs ∞ for the rank-deficient v1.0.139 design). Headline number: A_dipole = 0.228% f_CW with bootstrap σ = 0.0815% f_CW (NSIDE=8 super-pixels, N_boot=1000). Interpretation (i) at A=1.7% f_CW remains formally excluded at z_boot = -18.1σ. Result is consistent with v1.0.139 within Δz < 1σ, confirming the v1.0.139 conclusion was not an artifact of the rank-deficiency hygiene issue.
